The lesions are characterized as petechiae or palpable purpura (Figure 2A), and may occasionally blister. They are commonly found on the face, palms and soles of the feet (Figure 2B). The lesions are induced by the formation of immune complexes and neutrophilic infiltration, and the presence of vasculitic lesions strongly relates to systemic disease activity [46].
